# Copilot instructions

Before implementation, read `AGENTS.md` and `SPEC.md`. Work only on the
requested slice, keep changes aligned with the agreed specification, and ask
before resolving product decisions that the spec marks open.

Do not persist chat content on the server or add model tools beyond web search,
date/time, and sandboxed code execution. Keep prompts/context small for the
local model. Never expose or log secrets.
